capabilities: Build battle map scenes with square or hex grids
Place tokens and save reusable encounters
Reveal fog of war with a separate player view
Roll dice and track initiative turns
Pin and edit Markdown notes on the map
extras: Desktop only for now. Local play needs no account; online play (closed beta) and sharing in the Armarium require an Atlas account with closed beta access. Full documentation with screenshots and clips is hosted at atlas-vtt.dev. Free software under AGPL-3.0 with no telemetry or ads; scenes save as .atlasmap files that sync with the vault.
motivation: Built as part of the author's bachelor's thesis to give the TTRPG community an open source, hackable, free virtual tabletop.
problem: Running tabletop RPG sessions needs a virtual tabletop, but existing ones rely on subscriptions and someone else's database rather than local files.

relations.evidence: Link creature notes with the optional Fantasy Statblocks plugin.
Atlas Sidebar is an optional companion plugin.
With Obsidian Sync, turn on "Sync all other types".

summary: Game-system agnostic virtual tabletop for tabletop RPGs inside Obsidian, with battle maps, tokens, fog of war, grids, dice and a separate player view.
